snippet.title: Istaria 20th Anniversary
snippet.description:
It's our 20th Anniversary and what better way to celebrate than a video! From our low resolution, interlaced beginnings, to a high fidelity vision of the future, we're on this journey with you! Special thanks to Pryzm the Dragon, Racktor, Ranqthas and Firebrand for their beginning days footage. And a big Thank You to Zaroclaw for creating this amazing video!

Happy Anniversary Istarians!
#istaria #dragons #fantasy #mmorpg #mmo
